Round 216 fails on two Low findings. Both are in A's own deliverables, the harness spec and doc 169; nothing is wrong in the product. All four real-browser rows ran, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true, and no row is blocked.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| SCOPE-216 (start + end) | PASS: HEAD `eb9e76e`; 4 modified docs + 3 new files; frozen-file hashes rc 0; each doc change is l.4 only, byte for byte. |
| RT-FIX-216 | PASS: the retro diff matches B's fix exactly; 10 gate reviews (200, 201, 202, 209 and 212 have none); the citation is l.38–41; `lessons.md` is 47 lines with exactly 3 changes. |
| PERF-RUN-216 | **FAIL (Low, C-R216-02).** Both runs exit 0 in about 59 s with no failures and React 18.3.1; all 61 rows are measured 3 times; my placeholder `latest.json` and `latest-interactions.json` files were left untouched. Only the determinism check fails. |
| PROBE-216 (my own CDP code) | PASS: memory at ready 140.34 MiB, export peak +64.96 MiB, 17 elements per clip, 355,155 B of JS on `/studio-lab`. All within tolerance of A's numbers. |
| REDPROOF-216 | PASS: my three test-breaking edits (wrong sample rate in the frame check, Ctrl+D removed, an impossible budget) each fail on the expected row, and none hangs. A's M1–M4 logs agree. |
| DOC-216 | **FAIL (Low, C-R216-01).** |
| AN-REVIEW-216 | PASS: typecheck rc 0; no `any`, type assertions, `@ts-*` or lint suppressions; formatting is clean. |
| G216-3 (1440×900 and 1280×720) | PASS: `/studio-lab` opens anonymously with the demo badge; `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio; the studio-token endpoint returns 401 with no header and 500 with a fake Bearer (no mock backend running). No token is issued, so premium auth is not bypassed. |
| STUDIO-SMOKE-216 (real mouse, both viewports) | PASS: `czaba-studio-lab.wav` downloads as PCM, 2 ch, 48 kHz, 24-bit; 4,864,896 frames, 0 frames off the "WAV created" text; real audio (RMS −15.3 dBFS); 0 page errors. |

**The two findings, for B:**
- **C-R216-01:** doc 169 has no `## არქიტექტურა` heading. The template and all six earlier docs (163–168) have one; its diagram sits inside `## მიდგომა` instead.
- **C-R216-02:** three `mem-polls` rows are marked deterministic but their medians differ between runs (for example 7, 8, 8 and 9 for `mem-polls-1`). A's own two runs already differed, so §2.5 says they should have left the deterministic set. The harness never notices because `mem-polls` isn't in its determinism list. Marking assert rows deterministic does follow the existing budget files, but `budgets.json` marks its timing-dependent liveness rows wallclock, which is the same case. All the ≥ 5 checks pass; only the label and note need changing.
- **Why two Lows fail the round:** like round 215, these are defects in the round's own deliverable against its own acceptance rows. Under §6 that means a bounded fix-up of those two rows, not a move to the deferred Low list.

**Still open for B or root:**
- A's question on the 0.1 MiB rounding difference still needs B's ruling.
- Four late spec changes were never seen by A's code-reviewer; root's reviewer should cover them.
- A says a peak measured strictly inside the export window would be about 37.2 MiB. My probe can neither confirm nor refute that.
- `mem-polls-1` came out at 7–8 in my runs against a minimum of 5, so the small margin A flagged is real.

The demo export also shows an "Overload … 14 samples clipped" warning at Master 0 dB. That is the known, already acknowledged class C-R86-OBS-DEFAULT-OVERLOAD, and no app file changed this round. I changed no source. The two placeholder files I added under `test-results/perf/` have been deleted, and the :5189 probe server is stopped.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; open `c-round-216.md` first.
